mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS trainerId, u.name AS trainerName FROM trainer t JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.gym_id = #{value} ORDER BY u.name

SELECT ps.id AS id, ps.trainer_id AS trainerId, trainer_user.name AS trainerName, ps.client_id AS clientId, client_user.name AS clientName, DATE_FORMAT(ps.start_time, '%H:%i') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(ps.end_time, '%H:%i') AS endTime, ps.status AS status, HOUR(ps.start_time) AS startHour, WEEKDAY(ps.start_time) + 1 AS dayOfWeek, CASE WHEN s.Diet = 1 THEN '식단' WHEN s.Yoga = 1 THEN '요가' WHEN s.Hypertrophy = 1 THEN '근비대' WHEN s.Body_Building = 1 THEN '보디빌딩' WHEN s.Strength = 1 THEN '스트렝스' WHEN s.Rehabilitation = 1 THEN '재활' ELSE '' END AS specialization FROM pt_session ps JOIN trainer t ON ps.trainer_id = t.id JOIN user trainer_user ON t.user_id = trainer_user.id JOIN member m ON ps.client_id = m.id JOIN user client_user ON m.user_id = client_user.id LEFT JOIN specialization s ON ps.trainer_id = s.trainer_id WHERE t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ps.start_time >= #{weekStart} AND ps.start_time < #{weekEnd} ORDER BY ps.start_time ASC
